how_reached: launched when a newer codex-cli existed on npm; the update offer is drawn before the TUI and before any turn.
ground_truth: 'Update available! 0.154.0 -> 0.155.1' with options '› 1. Update now (runs `npm install -g @openai/codex`)' / '2. Skip' / '3. Skip until next version' and footer 'Press enter to continue'. Pressing Enter here starts a package install, which is exactly the damage a mis-classified write can do (see README, incident).
